A.text: Oral manifestations in people with SHCN differ in cause, frequency, and severity.

cites.section: Management of Dental Patients with Special Health Care Needs › Background

B.text: Because manifestations differ in cause and severity, they are not identical across conditions.

cites.section: Management of Dental Patients with Special Health Care Needs › Background

C.text: Frequency of oral manifestations differs, so it is not the same in every special health care need.

cites.section: Management of Dental Patients with Special Health Care Needs › Background

D.text: Cause also differs, so manifestations do not always share one cause.

cites.section: Management of Dental Patients with Special Health Care Needs › Background

explanation.text: Oral manifestations vary in cause, frequency, and severity, so findings in one SHCN group cannot be assumed to apply to others.
